success.narration: The spring yields between two bell strokes. You pin every copied page behind the amber glass, names and payments facing the street, then close the hasp without a sound. By morning, nobody will need your permission to know.

payload.note: Mira publishes her entire packet of Venn’s void orders in the Office notice cage and keeps no secret copy.

payload.what: Mira placed her entire packet of Venn’s void orders in the Office of Amber Weights public notice cage, keeping no secret copy.

nearMiss.narration: The hasp opens, but the office bell gives one clipped note. You get every page behind the glass before a lamp ignites upstairs. The evidence is public; so is the fact that someone breached the cage.

payload.note: Mira publishes her entire packet of Venn’s void orders in the Office notice cage and keeps no secret copy.

fail.narration: The spring snaps back and the office bell rings twice. A lamp blooms behind the amber windows; boots strike the stair. The packet is still in your hand, but the office network now knows someone tried to breach its public cage.
